title: BridgeRouter: Gain-Aware Instance Routing over Cross-Modal Bridge Portfolios
abstract: arXiv:2610.38152v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Lightweight representation bridges make pretrained, task-adapted EEG foundation models executable on other biosignal modalities without retraining their backbones. However, selecting a single bridge pathway globally assigns every instance to the same transfer route and ignores complementary errors across routes. We therefore formulate multi-bridge transfer as an instance-level algorithm-selection problem and introduce BridgeRouter, a gain-aware router over a portfolio of frozen cross-modal pathways. A validation-selected Single Best Solver (SBS) serves as a protected default route. During training, task labels are used to compute the reduction in negative log-likelihood provided by each alternative route relative to the SBS, and a lightweight MLP predicts these route-specific gains from a target-modality representation extracted by a frozen encoder. At inference, BridgeRouter observes only the target modality, requires neither EEG, task

translated_title: BridgeRouter：跨模态桥接组合上的增益感知实例路由
translated_abstract: 轻量级表示桥接使经过预训练、任务适配的EEG基础模型能够在其他生物信号模态上运行，而无需重新训练其主干网络。然而，全局选择单一桥接通路会将每个实例分配到同一条迁移路线，忽略了不同路线之间互补性的误差。因此，我们将多桥接迁移形式化为一个实例级的算法选择问题，并提出BridgeRouter——一个在冻结跨模态通路组合上进行选择的增益感知路由器。通过验证集选出的单一最佳求解器（SBS）作为受保护的默认路线。在训练过程中，利用任务标签计算每条备选路线相对于SBS所带来的负对数似然减少量，并由一个轻量级MLP从冻结编码器提取的目标模态表示中预测这些路线特定的增益。在推理阶段，BridgeRouter仅观察目标模态，既不需要EEG数据，也不需要任务……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出BridgeRouter，一种增益感知的实例级路由器，能在多个冻结的跨模态迁移通路中为每个实例动态选择最优路线，使预训练EEG基础模型无需重训主干即可更好地迁移到其他生物信号模态。
en_tdlr: BridgeRouter is a gain-aware, instance-level router that dynamically selects the optimal transfer route from a portfolio of frozen cross-modal pathways, enabling pretrained EEG foundation models to transfer to other biosignal modalities without retraining their backbones.
